name: Mahattava

related.relation: the neighbour it never bowed to

facts.text: Mahattava is a level-66 named with 30,000 health; 28 fjarskafinn come with it.
It casts Mahattava's Infection over time and a 300-damage strike.
Allakhazam calls it a named fjarskafinn in the room with the single waterfall and lake, hitting for 300-400; players thought it was over level 70 (2003).

story:
In the lake under the single waterfall live the fjarskafinn, finned and muck-scaled, slow and old and very many. They are not the old one's brood. They were in the lake before her, when the iron trees above were still silver, if the narfi are to be believed, and they have never bowed to her. Mahattava is the mightiest of them, as its name in an old eastern tongue says: a thing as big as a boat, with a dorsal fin like a sail and scales caked with the muck of the lake bottom, that has lived so long in that water that the water has started to take its shape.

It has made its peace with Iarnvidiur the way a pike makes peace with a heron: each stays out of the other's water. Her wolves do not drink from the lake. Her plague does not touch the fish, or if it does they do not seem to care. In return Mahattava does not come out. Nobody knows what it eats. The dwarves say it eats whatever falls into the lake, and that the old one makes sure enough falls in.

Its school is enormous. Pull Mahattava and the lake empties at you: twenty-eight fjarskafinn, every one of them coming up out of the black water at once, and the mighty one among them striking for three or four hundred a blow and laying an infection on whoever it hits. Players who first met it in 2003 guessed it was far higher than the level the scholars gave it. They were right. Two of them took ten percent off it and went home.

Its scales make shields, muck-covered and heavy and good against fire. The dwarves say a shield made from Mahattava's scale has never once been burned through, because something of the lake's cold stays in it forever.
legend: Mahattava brings twenty-eight fjarskafinn. That is not a typo. Area damage, a wall of tanks at the lake edge, and patience. Pull it to the shore so the school comes out of the water in a line. Two players took ten percent off it in 2003 and decided against the rest. Its fish-scale shield is a fine drop, with a charged cold blast. Cure its infection on the tanks. Area damage classes are the heroes here: runemasters, spiritmasters with pets on the line, and anyone with a big point blank area spell. Have a rezzer ready for the aoe group, the fish turn on them.

loremasterTopic.text: The mightiest of the fjarskafinn in the lake under the single waterfall, and the one thing in the lair [Iarnvidiur] did not breed.

bookPage: From Thorgrim of Faraheim's notes. The dwarves told me the lake under the single waterfall has no bottom, or rather that its bottom is very far down and very old, and that the fish came up from there long ago. They say the mighty one is the oldest living thing on Aegir that is not a tree. I asked whether it was older than the old one. They said yes, and that she knows it, and that this is why her wolves do not drink from the lake. They said even the old one has someone she is careful of.
